external_baseline.name: Bidirectional Beam Search (BBS)
external_baseline.paper: Efficient trace reconstruction in DNA storage systems using bidirectional beam search

dataset_note: CNR provides explicit centers and clustered physical nanopore reads in matching order. The dataset README notes a 2024-discovered long-range dependency in the generated centers and possible malformed clusters; the benchmark preserves failures and does not claim the centers are uniformly random.
claim_scope: Physical-read trace reconstruction only. The external strands were not encoded by OligoArk, so OligoArk archive-level fountain/hybrid redundancy, combined optimizer, payload SHA-256 decoding, synthesis overhead and end-to-end file recovery are not applicable.
